name: deck-renderer
body: Deck renderer: assembles the whole-deck reveal.js document — applies theme CSS, reveal.js config (navigationMode passed through from `navigation`), vertical stacks, anchors and notes — over the per-slide documents. A numbered slide with letter slides renders as a plain outer `<section>` wrapper (no id or class) whose first child is the horizontal slide's own `<section>` (keeping its anchor id) and whose subsequent children are its letter slides' `<section>`s in letter order; a numbered slide with no letter slides renders as a single `<section>`. Owns internal/render/deck.go (RenderDeck plus renderDeckSlide, themeStylesheet and wrapVerticalStack); wrapVerticalStack builds the plain outer `<section>` wrapper for a vertical stack. It is the top-level entry internal/server.Reloader.renderDefault calls, and RenderDeck's complete page is what `kalide render --full` writes for a slide (cli-render). The render tier splits by role: solution.component.renderer executes templates and section instances bottom-up (internal/render/render.go); deck-renderer assembles the resulting deck document (internal/render/deck.go).
